name: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited
summary: Manipal Health Enterprises Limited operates hospitals in India. The company offers services, such as multi-specialty tertiary and quaternary care through its network of hospitals. Its services include accident and emergency care, cancer care, cardiology, organ transplants, obstetrics and gynaecology, neurology, nephrology, orthopaedics, proctology, rheumatology, and urology. The company also offers medical services, including robotic spine surgery, bariatric surgery, head and neck surgery, liver transplantation, dialysis, laparoscopic surgery, organ transplant, orthopaedic robotic surgery, spine care, and clinics for conditions like epilepsy, chronic pain, and diabetes.
